homepage.heroInlineStatement: is the most advanced, integrated, and popular dispatching software available.
homepage.heroSupportCopy: Built for emergency services dispatching and record management, Sonoran CAD is the most customizable system available. Dispatch faster, organize records efficiently, and scale your departments like never before.

erlc.description: Official ER:LC in-game integration with live map and more.

best.answer: Sonoran CAD is the most advanced and widely used CAD systems for gaming communities, including ER:LC. With full ER:LC integration provided on the free plan, your community can be up and running in minutes.
best.question: Is Sonoran CAD the best CAD for ER:LC?

community.answer: Absolutely. The free plan is ideal for small to mid-sized communities, offering full ER:LC functionality without limitations. You can upgrade later if your server grows and needs additional accounts or features.
community.question: Is this suitable for small or growing communities?

features.answer:
The integration includes a full suite of real-time features such as:
- Live 3D map with player and unit tracking
- Automated 911 call syncing
- Traffic stop automation and hotkey
- Plate reader automation and hotkey
- Vehicle and character creation automation
- and much more
features.question: What features are included with the ER:LC integration?

free.answer: Yes, the ER:LC integration is fully available on the free version of Sonoran CAD. Paid plans are only needed if you want to add more user accounts or scale your community, but all core ER:LC features work without upgrading.
free.question: Is the ER:LC integration free to use?

setup.answer: Setup typically takes less than 10 minutes. You simply generate your ER:LC API key, paste it into Sonoran CAD, and paste our webhook URL in the ER:LC server menu. No coding or advanced setup is required.
setup.question: How long does it take to set up the integration?
